title: Observability Ingest v2 Request
description: Request envelope for POST /api/v2/observability/events (14-observability-ingest-v2 §2.1). At most 100 events and 5 MiB of HTTP JSON per request. Tenant/project scope is derived from the authenticated credential and is NEVER a client field — additionalProperties:false rejects any attempt to select scope in the body. The SDK generates ingest_id once per request and event_id once per event; both survive local-outbox retry.

protocol_version.description: Ratified v2 protocol version. Requests that omit or mismatch this are rejected.

events.description: One-to-100 versioned delta events. Each event is one broker message; the request-level 5 MiB cap is enforced by the admission edge (x-max-request-bytes), not by JSON Schema.
